messages:
eva_sales: Quick thread — AuroraHealth wants a HIPAA POC. Traffic profile: steady 180 qps, predictable 7-9am spike window to ~1,100 qps (avg ~70 tokens) with occasional 2-3m blips to 1.5k. They asked for a recommended reserved plan, preheat steps, an autoscale snippet, and a clear conditional p99 SLA. Need by EOD tomorrow.

jon_eng: For 70 tokens, our A100 baseline is ~260 qps/GPU. For 1,100 peak we should reserve 5 GPUs (gives ~1,300 qps) to have headroom. Add 2 burst credits for 1.5k blips. Recommend reserved_gpus=5, burst_credits=2.

sam_sre: Agree on 5+2. KV shard guidance: shards = 10 (2 per GPU) to minimize hot key pressure. Preheat plan: staggered warmup starting 25m prior, finish ~5m before window. Include weight warm and KV warm. Example command for docs:

redwood preheat --project aurora-poc --model gpt-med-quant --shards 10 --duration 25m --warm_weights true --stagger 30s

lina_prod: Fallback model: gpt-compact-int8. Route preference: reserved -> burst_pool -> degraded_shared. We'll instrument quality checks during fallback and a rollback trigger if regression > 8% on eval set.

maya_ops: Ops knobs: global_rate_limit:1600qps, queue_max:700, token-based fair-queueing. Add shedding policy that drops low-priority background jobs first. Also recommend AZ spread across 3 AZs for the POC.

eva_sales: Can someone paste a short autoscale snippet I can include in the SOW?

jon_eng: Pasteable YAML for SOW:

autoscale: reserved_gpus: "5"; burst_credits: "2"; preheat_minutes: "25"; kv_shards: "10"; az_spread: "3"; scale_up_policy: "target_util:60%, cooldown_s:15"; scale_down_policy: "grace_s:240"; degraded_model: "gpt-compact-int8"

sam_sre: SLA blurb we can return: "Redwood commits to p99 < 250ms when serving from reserved capacity (reserved_gpus=5) with KV warmed and no eviction. If requests are served from burst credits or degraded model, p99 may increase to 400-700ms. POC SOW will include rollback triggers and measured fallback windows."

legal_jordan: For HIPAA: BAA required, customer-managed KMS supported (envelope encryption), audit logs retention >=90d, VPC/PrivateLink recommended. Send their security questionnaire and I'll mark required responses.

eva_sales: I've uploaded the questionnaire to the deal room. Legal, can you confirm BAA wording by EOD?

quota-bot: Estimated cost for a 30-day POC (ballpark): reserved (5 GPUs) + expected burst usage -> ~5 * $X/day + variable. Finance to confirm exact $/day.

maya_ops: Runbook triggers: if p99 > 300ms for 90s -> page oncall and scale-check; if sustained > 400ms for 2m -> auto-roll to degraded_model and notify customer; manual override available to disable preheat.

lina_prod: Also add a short note on quantization: int8/4bit variants may change output characteristics; include a small prompt eval during preheat to validate. We'll add telemetry hooks.

eva_sales: Perfect. I'll bundle reserved_gpus:5, burst_credits:2, preheat:25m, autoscale YAML, SLA blurb, runbook, and legal checklist into the SOW and send to Aurora tomorrow AM. Thanks team :pray:
